title: mineirella goyazensis
intro: Mineirella goyazensis, commonly known as the Brazilian rosewood or Goiás rosewood, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Mineirella goyazensis include analgesic and antipyretic effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Mineirella goyazensis and its potential uses in traditional medicine.
